title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Medications
description: Whether the participant used any medication (other than HRT) for most of the last 4 weeks, and which specific medications, reported at the 3-year resurvey.

F1MED.title: Used any medication/drug (not HRT) for most of the last 4 weeks
F1MED.$comment: Steward confirmed this gates all 19 specific medication fields below, same shape as parental_mortality's F1MALIVE gate over its cause-of-death block (D071) -- the real questionnaire wording asks 'if yes, was it...' before listing the specific drugs, so a No answer here means the specific-drug checkboxes were never reached -- D075.

F1MEDTHY.title: Medication: thyroxine
F1MEDTHY.x-universe: Participants who used a medication in the last 4 weeks (F1MED=1).
F1MEDTHY.$comment: Checkbox-style: the source documents only '1=Yes', no '2=No'. not_applicable is pinned when F1MED=2 (No medication) -- D075. Within the F1MED=1 universe, an unchecked box still falls to missing_numeric -- checkbox semantics mean most of the 19 fields are legitimately non-1 for any given participant, so no applicability rule forces this field real even when F1MED=1.
